items.description: 30 June - 1 July 2016: I attended the Merriman Summer School, Ennis, County Clare as a Panel Member on the topic 'To find the answering voices that they seek': Ireland (North & South), Britain and Europe - In the aftermath of the UK Referendum. Received 1 night accommodation and meal (�110) and an Honorarium (�200). (Registered 3 April 2017) 23 - 24 February 2017: I attended the Centre for Cross Border Studies Annual Conference in Armagh on the topic 'Building and maintaining future relationships; within, across and beyond these islands'. Received a meal and 1 night accommodation. (Registered 3 April 2017) 13 - 15 October 2017: I attended the Annual Conference of European Young Conservatives (4 Matthew Parker Street,London, SW1H 9HQ), held in Warsaw, as an invited speaker. I received cost of flights (�550) and cost of hotel accommodation (�327). (Registered 23 October 2017) 29 November - 2 December 2018: On behalf of the Ulster Unionist Party, I attended the international conference, 'Twenty Years of Peace: Progress and Possibilities in Northern Ireland', at Yale University (New Haven, Connecticut) to mark the 20th anniversary of the Good Friday Agreement. Yale University paid for the return flight business class (Dublin to New York), airport transfers, hospitality, subsistence and two nights' accommodation at the Omni Hotel. (Registered 18 December 2018) 27 - 28 February 2019: As an invited panellist, I attended the conference Brexit and the Future of British- Irish Relations, held at National University of Ireland, Galway. The University of Notre Dame (Dublin) paid for hotel accommodation and return travel by train. (Registered 15 March 2019) 13 -14 September 2019: I attended the Alternative Arrangements Commission Roundtable Conference. Prosperity UK covered the cost of four meals and one night's accommodation in the Carrickdale Hotel, Dundalk, County Louth. (Registered 17 October 2019) 2 - 4 March 2022: I travelled to an event in Brussels, hosted by the European Political group Renew Europe for the purposes of explaining the Unionist position and opposition to the Northern Ireland Protocol. The event happened on 3 March 2022, in the Renaissance Hotel, followed by visits to the European Parliament and dinner with Renew Europe members, EU, Irish and UK government officials. I travelled out on 2 March 2022 and returned to Northern Ireland on 4 March 2022. The estimated value of the travel, accommodation, food and hospitality was �630. These costs where met in whole by Renew Europe. (Registered 10 March 2022) �

items.description: On 14th - 16th February 2008 I attended the International School for Peace Studies, Messines, Belgium to meet and talk to young participants on the school's Link Programme facilitated by the David Ervine Foundation. The cost was met by FAS - Training and Employment Authority. On 28th October - 1st November 2009 I attended and spoke at the graduation of participants of Wider Horizons programme in Pittsburgh, P.A., U.S.A. I also took part in a panel debate in University of Pittsburgh. The cost was met by the Ireland Institute of Pittsburgh. On 27th - 28th January 2011 I attended the International Converence on 'Enhancing the Role of Women in Reconciliation and Accountability in Iraq through Socio-Political Empowerment' in Erbil, Kurdistan-Iraq. The cost was met by the International Alliance for Justice and No Peace without Justice, in partnership with the Foundation for the Future and the Westminster Foundation for Democracy. (Registered 21 February 2011) On 14 - 18 March 2011 I travelled to the United States to meet with members of the US Congress and local GGOs as part of a Family Planning Association delegation to discuss access to abortion services in Northern Ireland. The cost was met by JRSST Charitable Trust. (Registered 24 March 2011) �
